checks.description: A4 to C5 to A4 uses one voice throughout. Pressing C5 restarts Attack; returning to A4 does not restart amp.

behavior: One key.trigger occurs at 0 s and another at 0.5 s. At 0.5 s, amp restarts a full 10 ms Attack from its current value.
At 0.5 s, key.pitch immediately becomes 72 and key.velocity becomes 0.8; oscillator phase continues.
At 1 s, selection returns to the held A4: key.pitch = 69, key.velocity = 0.4, key.gate stays at 1, and no trigger is sent.
The last key releases at 1.5 s. Pitch and velocity are retained; the 300 ms Release finishes at 1.8 s.
